text:
Jen (CEO): Thanks everyone for coming — appreciate the energy and the tough questions. Quick thread to capture the follow-ups and owners.
Matt (VP Eng): Can we clarify Dedicated GA date and what 'beta customers only' means?
Jen (CEO): Rough target is late July for GA, but we'll keep a controlled ramp. 'Beta customers only' = customers on the early access contract + a small set of pre-approved partners.
Priya (Product): Will the GA include the new autoscaling policies demo'd today?
Matt (VP Eng): Yes — autoscaling v1 (policy + burst) ships in GA. v2 (predictive scaling) is Q4.
Sam (Eng): Action: create a one-pager for customers about autoscaling guarantees + rollback behavior. Owner: @Sam. ETA: 7/3.
Alex (Infra): Question from infra: what are the minimum onprem HW specs for Private deploy? We need to add to docs.
Priya (Product): Good call. Action: Priya + Alex to draft a short spec + checklist for onprem installs. Owner: @Alex, @Priya. ETA: 7/10.
Maya (People Ops): Small ask — can leadership share verbatim of the roadmap Q&A summary for folks who couldn't attend?
Jen (CEO): We'll publish a short Q&A summary and link to the recording. Owner: @Maya to coordinate with comms. ETA: 6/30.
Sam (Eng): There was a perf question about 2k token sequences and quantized models — short answer?
Matt (VP Eng): TL;DR: quantized 8-bit variants keep latency within ~1.2x for short sequences, but long (2k+) tails are impacted; caching + continuous batching recommended. We'll post the perf slides.
Priya (Product): Action: publish the perf tradeoffs slide and a recommended config matrix (batch size, KV cache enabled, quantization profile). Owner: @Priya. ETA: 7/5.
Jen (CEO): Ops question: will there be a migration path for Dedicated customers who later want Private?
Matt (VP Eng): Yes – data plane portability and model pinning make transitions possible. We'll create a migration checklist. Owner: @Matt. ETA: 7/14.
deploy-bot: Recording uploaded: https://redwood.company/s/ah/2789123456/recording
Jen (CEO): Thanks — last ask: if you raised something in the Q&A and don't see it captured here, drop a reply and we'll add owners.
Priya (Product): I'll consolidate these items into the product board and tag owners.
Sam (Eng): Noted, I'll open the autoscaling one-pager draft in #docs-drafts and ping reviewers.
Alex (Infra): I'll start the onprem spec doc and share a shortlist of required components.
Maya (People Ops): I'll put the Q&A summary in the all-hands folder and ping the company when live.
Jen (CEO): Great — closing this thread. If anyone wants to volunteer for trouble-shooting customer migration scenarios, reply here. :sparkles:
Sam (Eng): Happy to help.
Matt (VP Eng): Same.
Priya (Product): Will join for migration runbook review.
